samples.question: The picture shows one square panel enclosed by a blue frame. The panel is divided into a grid of 5 rows and 5 columns of equal square cells, and the cell edges are not drawn. Every cell is printed with the same two greys: a fine speckle of tiny dark blocks on a light background, identical in tone everywhere, but packed more densely in some cells than in others. Blur the panel, or step far back from it, until the individual blocks can no longer be told apart and each cell becomes one flat tone; the densely packed cells then read as the darker cells. Exactly 9 of the 25 cells are the darker ones. Ignore the small orange squares printed on top of the speckle: they are decoration and carry no information about the answer. The 9 darker cells of the blurred grid form a shape that most closely matches one of these six symbols: diamond, ell, ex, flag, plus, zee. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
